name: Ditching the Scum, Ruling the School
original_name: Ditching the Scum, Ruling the School
overview: As the fake heiress of the powerful Hart family, Lily spends years chasing the love of a man who only uses her. After being betrayed and pushed to the edge, she wakes up with a vision of the tragic fate waiting for her. With only three months before her true identity is exposed, she secretly prepares her escape and fights back. This time, Lily won't beg for a place in their world—she'll build one of her own.
